_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, change member-onboarding (REQ-MOB-006 / REQ-MOB-008). A governance body names, per role, the Nextcloud groups a member in that role belongs to. Provisioning on an onboarding adds the member to the groups of their role; revocation on an offboarding removes them from every group the body maps, and from no other group. The groups must already exist: provisioning never creates a group. Chair and signatory scopes are not listed here; they follow from the roster through the role-to-scope projection.

memberGroups.title: Member groups
memberGroups.description: Per role, the Nextcloud groups a member of this body is added to when they join and removed from when they leave.
memberGroups.x-notes: Keys are the roles of a member onboarding (chair, vice-chair, secretary, treasurer, member, observer, guest). Empty means nothing is mapped: provisioning then refuses with a named error instead of reporting success.
